message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/devel/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":22,"var":"data,size","code":"gnutls_datum_t raw = {(unsigned char*)data, (unsigned int)size};","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz input are wrapped as a PKCS#12 datum."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/devel/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":38,"var":"p12","code":"ret = gnutls_pkcs12_import(p12, &raw, GNUTLS_X509_FMT_DER, 0);","note":"The raw input is parsed into an in-memory PKCS#12 object."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1458,"var":"p12","code":"for (;;) { ... ret = gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag(p12, idx, bag);","note":"The parser iterates over each authenticatedSafe entry in the attacker-controlled PKCS#12 structure."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag","line":1290,"var":"bag->element[0].data","code":"result = _gnutls_x509_read_value(c2, root2, &bag->element[0].data);","note":"For encrypted content, the bag payload is copied into the bag object for later decryption and parsing."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1488,"var":"data","code":"ret = gnutls_pkcs12_bag_get_data(bag, i, &data);","note":"The bag element data is exposed to the higher-level parser as a datum."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1508,"var":"*key","code":"ret = gnutls_x509_privkey_import_pkcs8(*key, &data, GNUTLS_X509_FMT_DER, password, ...);","note":"The datum is interpreted as a PKCS#8 private key, which drives deeper parsing of attacker-controlled bytes."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1530,"var":"bag","code":"gnutls_pkcs12_bag_deinit(bag);","note":"The temporary bag is destroyed after parsing, freeing the heap storage that held the decoded bag contents."},
{"step":8,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/devel/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":55,"var":"p12","code":"gnutls_pkcs12_deinit(p12);","note":"The top-level PKCS#12 object is released, which can invalidate internal pointers derived from the parsed bag data."},
{"step":9,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1518,"var":"key","code":"if (ret >= 0) { gnutls_x509_privkey_deinit(key); ... }","note":"The caller later tears down the parsed key object; the vulnerability hypothesis is that one of the earlier parse paths leaves a stale pointer that is read during cleanup or subsequent key handling, producing a heap-use-after-free read."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/cand_100.p12 /workspace/candidate_trace.json 2>&1 | head -120
